howToUse: Pay a monthly Walmart+ membership with a card on the account.

quotes.text: Basic U.S. Consumer Platinum Card Members can receive a statement credit for one Walmart+ monthly membership fee (up to $12.95 plus applicable taxes)
Purchases of any membership Plus Ups (for example, Walmart InHome) and purchases of Walmart Business+ memberships are not eligible for this benefit.

eligibleChannels: 直接向Walmart支付自动续费的月度Walmart+会员
conditionalPurchases: 每账户每月仅首笔处理的合资格会员费；不能每张附属卡各报一份
12.95美元为基数，另有适用税费；不能当作所有情形的绝对报销封顶

content.title: CLEAR+ 会员抵扣
content.summary: 每自然年合计最高219美元CLEAR+年会员费；自动续费，适用税费和额外费用不在本次公布覆盖内。
howToUse: 确认实际年会员费及CLEAR批准，不把申请本身当作已获会员。
主副卡合计自然年219美元；本项会自动续费。
退款会影响已获抵扣；预计最长8周到账。

original.title: CLEAR+ Credit
original.summary: Up to $219 a calendar year when a card on the account pays for an annual CLEAR+ membership; CLEAR enrollment is required.
howToUse: Pay for the CLEAR+ membership with a card on the account.

quotes.text: Basic Card Members can earn up to $219 in statement credits per calendar year when their Platinum Card or Additional Cards on the Account are used to pay for an annual CLEAR+ Membership.

eligibleChannels: 合资格卡直接支付CLEAR+年会员费

content.title: 住宿预订抵扣
content.summary: 每半年最多300美元住宿报销；2027-01-01起FHR、THC及Airbnb Luxe均须连续两晚并由Amex Travel合资格渠道预付。
howToUse: 先确认合资格卡角色与预付渠道，不把普通酒店直订或任意Airbnb当作符合。
2027-01-01起FHR、THC及Airbnb Luxe都必须至少连续两晚。
半年截止以美国中部时间为准，处理须在周期内；报销最长可能90天。

original.title: $600 Lodging Credit
original.summary: Up to $300 semi-annually (January to June, July to December) on new prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts, The Hotel Collection and Airbnb Luxe bookings; from January 1, 2027 Fine Hotels + Resorts needs two nights.
howToUse: Prepay through AmexTravel.com, the Amex Travel App or by phone; ordinary hotel or Airbnb bookings do not count.
From January 1, 2027 Fine Hotels + Resorts requires two nights.

quotes.text: Basic Card Members on a U.S. Consumer Platinum Card Account are eligible to receive up to $300 in statement credits semi-annually (January to June, and July to December) for up to a total of $600 per calendar year
Effective January 1, 2027, Fine Hotels + Resorts bookings will require a minimum two-night stay to be eligible for the $600 Lodging Credit.

eligibleChannels: Amex Travel网站或App预付Pay Now
FHR/THC可通过合资格卡背电话预付渠道
excludedPurchases: 酒店现场另收的房费或杂费
保险费、利息、取消费、物业费等附加费用
非参与项目的酒店或Airbnb房源
conditionalPurchases: 2027-01-01起FHR、THC及Airbnb Luxe均须连续两晚；具体卡角色及渠道仍须符合。
Airbnb Luxe需关联Airbnb与Amex账户；不是任意Airbnb房源
Companion Platinum仅能用于THC及Airbnb Luxe，不能据此使用FHR；卡片角色须确认
